title: Check a plan against every rule, without the model
heading: A Run Stops at a Stated Gap, and Its Plan Is Checked Without the Model
cases: an allowed plan breaks nothing; a plan without its must-do, one with two alternatives, one over a region's budget and one outside a window each name exactly the rows they break
a child with a one-year lag may start the year after its parent, not the same year
a child funded without its parent breaks its precedence row
a two-year project's second-year cost counts against the second year's budget
spending exactly the budget is allowed; one more project over it is not
a two-year project keeps its crews in its second year
a region's floor counts each funded project's whole cost, not its first year
a region or program the snapshot gives no limit has no row, so its spend breaks nothing
